critical_code_review_comments: factory_os.knowledge_gap_check() falls back on the constant _STOP list — words like 'forex' overlap with KR-00075 'Forex' title (single-token) via topic_overlap/len(topic_tokens). For very short topics this can produce false positives (e.g., topic 'trading' would match many KRs). Consider requiring topic_overlap>=2 tokens when topic_tokens>=3 to avoid loose matches. Not blocking for this iteration.
routers/factory_os.py: /outcomes uses fos.outcomes_view() synchronously — fine today, but if outcomes ever query DB (e.g., dynamic maturity), convert to async and cache. Non-blocking.

CreateExperience.js launch() calls nav(plan.launch.route) unconditionally — the disabled flag on the button prevents click, but as a defense-in-depth check, guard inside launch() too (return early if !plan.can_launch). Minor safety.

Constitution.js filters sections on q with only n/title/summary — the const-search does not search the full_text. Acceptable since sections are the UI unit, but a note in placeholder ('searches section titles & summaries') would set expectations.

governance_binding.CONSTITUTION_BINDINGS is a module-level constant — future amendments to sections (§14 revision) must update this list; recommend adding an integration test that asserts every section referenced in bindings exists in SECTIONS.
